evidence.title: MX Icons - Open Source React Icon Library | 5,600+ Icons
GitHub - ig-imanish/mx-icons: A modern, lightweight React icon library with beautiful SVG icons

name: MX Icons
summary: Open-source React icon library of 5,600+ SVG icons in outline, solid and 16px mini variants.
description: A React icon library shipped as tree-shakeable SVG components with no dependencies beyond React 18 or 19. Every icon comes in outline, solid and mini (16px) versions, and components accept size, color and className props; icons are added through pull requests on GitHub. Live demo, icon browser and docs are linked from the README.
contains: 5,600+ icons in outline, solid and mini (16px) variants
tree-shakeable; only imported icons are bundled
props: size, color, className and other SVG attributes
